family_title_en: Replace the singular noun with a personal pronoun

stages.ix_title: Replace the singular noun with a personal pronoun
stages.choice_rule: Offer exactly four personal pronouns. One matches the gender, number, and case of the one singular noun. Include a gender miss, a case miss for people (he/him or she/her), and they or them as the plural miss. Animals and things take it. Never use I, me, we, or you as the key for a third-person noun.

roots: Each stem has exactly one singular noun a kid can replace. Do not add a second person, pet, or thing.
Choices are four personal pronouns only. Never write phrases or full sentences as choices.
The key matches gender, number, and case. Subject nouns take he, she, or it. Object nouns take him, her, or it.
Always include they or them so kids cannot treat a singular noun as plural.
For a person, include the case twin (he with him, she with her) and the other gender.
Pets, animals, and things take it. Do not make he or she the key for a cat, dog, puppy, ball, or book.
Never use I, me, we, or you as the key for a third-person noun.
Do not use NAME. A name token has no gender, so he and she cannot be keyed.
Keep stems in kid world: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands.
Keep answers unique. Only one pronoun can be right.

tier_rules.1: Stems of three to five words with one obvious subject noun. Use he, she, or it. Pictures for pets and kids. Distractors are the other genders plus they.
tier_rules.2: Stems of four to seven words. Use two-syllable nouns such as puppy or grandma. Keep the noun in subject place. Add a case miss (him or her) beside they.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss object case. The noun comes after the verb, so the key is him or her, not he or she. Stems may run longer, still under ten words.

he_male.en: A boy or man is he when he does the action.
he_male.ko: 남자아이나 남자가 행동을 하면 he를 씁니다.

she_female.en: A girl or woman is she when she does the action.
she_female.ko: 여자아이나 여자가 행동을 하면 she를 씁니다.

it_thing.en: A pet, animal, or thing is it.

her_object.en: Use her for a girl or woman after the verb.
her_object.ko: 동사 뒤에서 여자아이나 여자를 가리킬 때는 her를 씁니다.

him_object.en: Use him for a boy or man after the verb.
him_object.ko: 동사 뒤에서 남자아이나 남자를 가리킬 때는 him을 씁니다.
